detail: 4x desk entry worst = 58.5 at 1-min load 4.52 and 58.7 at 1-min load 4.77; exit worst = 48.4-68.2 at 4.52 and 50.0-58.4 at 4.77. Nothing halves at the low end of the load range I could obtain (floor 4.52; no quiet window across two ~8-min polls). The decisive control is 1x: at load ~6.1 the same gestures read worst 10.2-10.3ms with long33=0 across all six cycles. A host-contention artifact would appear at 1x too. It does not, and the frames scale cleanly 4x->6x (58->91 entry, 50->76 exit). Bundle fact.

board-ready = 500.6 ms (chromium 1x desk, warm, unthrottled, my re-run; lane's banked file 502.3). Both fold-frames.mjs and my probe resolve BOARD_READY, then waitForTimeout(2000), then press 'g'. Every measured fold therefore begins >=2.5 s AFTER board-ready. No fold or unfold finding can move the readiness mark; none is on the board-ready critical path. They are on the GESTURE's critical path (the frame the user sees on press), which is a different path than the one this lens names. onCriticalPath:true is therefore ADJUSTED to false for findings 1,2,3,4,5 in the board-ready sense, with the gesture-path reading preserved.

Tagging useFlipGlide's own movers so restoreBoardAnims skips instead of finishes them drops no bake, thins no boil, removes no filter, shortens no transition, moves no golden, and does not touch filterBudget. It is a scheduling/ownership change and it makes the board DRAW MORE (520ms of travel that currently never renders), not less.
